# NonhomogPDE18.ScalarKernel

**ScalarKernel**

Scalar iterated Gaussian inverse kernel

**边界**：Fixed1809.02622v1 actual PDF pp2,5. Existing real analytic scalar proof, not actual postselection/PDE algorithm

**覆盖等级**：C
